displayName.ja: 【恋の夜会】 心願寺　紅

profile.ja: 吸血鬼と人間のハーフでありながら対魔忍として生きる異端の存在。祖父である“ふうま八将”心願寺幻庵から剣術の指南を受け、ゆくゆくは八将を継ぐと目されていた実力者。しかし、かつてのふうま宗家の反乱に連座して幻庵は失脚。跡目を継ぐはずだった紅もふうまの里を離れ、現在は闇の都市として名高いセンザキを拠点に独自に活動している。彼女が信じる“義”のために。
profile.en: She is a half-vampire, half-human outcast who lives as a Taimanin. She received swordsmanship instruction from her grandfather, the Fuuma Eight-General Shinganji Gen-an, and was once slated to inherit his position. However, because her grandfather was disgraced for aiding the Fuuma main family during an internal conflict, Kurenai left the Fuuma village and now operates independently with no allegiance. From her former Fuuma Eight-General lineage she is also an old acquaintance of Fuuma Kotaro, the heir of the main family. She can deliberately unleash the dormant "demon" power within herself to gain overwhelming strength. When she does, her eyes turn crimson, black wings sprout on her back, and she becomes surrounded by a miasma of darkness. In this demonic awakening, Kurenai possesses a terrifying power far beyond that of ordinary humans, but the price is that her body and mind are gradually consumed by the demon, causing her to lose her humanity and will over time.

text.ja: 潜入任務の準備、完了だ。エスコート期待しているぞ。……あんまりジロジロ見ないでくれ。なんだか照れてしまう
text.en: The infiltration prep is done. I'm counting on you for the escort… and don't stare so much. It's making me blush.

text.ja: 仕事とはいえ、こんなドレスを着るのは久しぶりだ。どうだろう。ちゃんと着こなせているだろうか？
text.en: Even for work, it's been a while since I've worn a dress like this. How does it look? Am I pulling it off properly?

text.ja: 馬子にも衣装とは言うが……。き、綺麗だって？　お世辞を言われたって何も出ないぞ！
text.en: Even a horseman has a costume, huh… So, it's beautiful? Flattery won't get you anything!

text.ja: お前と一緒にパーティに来れて少しドキドキしている……。いや、こんなの私らしくないな。忘れてくれ
text.en: I'm a bit nervous being at a party with you… No, that's not like me. Forget it.

text.ja: お前がエスコートしてくれるんだろう？　慣れない任務だが、おかげで安心できる。手を取ってもらうのは、少し照れるのだが
text.en: You're going to escort me, right? It's an unfamiliar mission, but thanks to you I feel at ease. It's a little embarrassing to have you take my hand, though.

text.ja: うん、なかなか良いシャンパンだ。飲み過ぎないように気を付けなければいけないな
text.en: Yeah, this champagne's pretty good. I need to be careful not to drink too much.

text.ja: 少し酔ってしまったかもしれない。すまないが、肩を貸してくれないか……。ふふ、やはりお前がいてくれると安心するな
text.en: I might've gotten a little tipsy. Sorry, but could you lend me a shoulder… Heh, having you here really puts me at ease.

text.ja: 肌が見えすぎじゃないかって？　確かにそうかもしれないが……。厄介者はお前がきっと追い払ってくれるだろうと信じてるからな
text.en: You think I'm showing too much skin? It might be true… but I trust you'll chase away any trouble.

text.ja: はぁ……、身体が火照って仕方ないんだ……。このままじゃ任務に支障が出てしまう。……悪いが、鎮めるのを手伝ってくれないか？
text.en: Ha… my body's burning up… If this keeps up, it'll mess with the mission. Sorry, could you help calm me down?

text.ja: お前も興奮しているのか？　ふふ……っ、気が合うな。だったら、まだ夜は長い。たっぷりと慰め合おうじゃないか
text.en: You're excited too? Heh… we get along well. Then the night's still long—let's comfort each other fully.

text.ja: んぁっ、だめ……っ、いやらしい触り方するなぁ……っ。責任取ってもらわないと困るぞ……。んん……っ
text.en: Ngh, no… don't touch me like that… I need you to take responsibility… mmm…
